issues.description: README ASR config link points to nonexistent conf/train/ subdirectory
issues.detail: README links the config as ./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml, but the file lives at ./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml. The link 404s and the README misdocuments the artifact it points to. Fix the path to match reality.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh warns about missing unzip and bad argv but does not exit
issues.detail: When unzip is missing the script only echoes and proceeds, later dying with an opaque error. The usage block on wrong argc also prints help without exit, falling through to realpath of an unset $1 under set -u. Add explicit exit 1 on both preconditions.

issues.description: db.sh added as both a regular file and a symlink at the same path
issues.detail: The diff adds egs2/tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1/db.sh twice: once as a standalone file setting TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH=downloads, and once as a symlink to ../../TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh. Two entries cannot occupy one path. Keep only the TEMPLATE symlink and edit the global db.sh.

issues.description: local/data.sh accepts --downloads_dir but never forwards it to download_and_untar.sh
issues.detail: The script declares downloads_dir= and parses options, but the advertised --downloads_dir flag is not propagated, so users cannot redirect the download location as the contract implies. Either remove the option or pass it through correctly.

issues.description: run.sh disables LM but README advertises LM decoding results
issues.detail: run.sh sets use_lm=false while README reports decode_asr_branchformer_lm_* results as reproducible. A user running the recipe as-is cannot reproduce the documented LM rows. Either default use_lm=true or document the required override.

issues.description: Hard-coded utterance counts and unquoted args under set -euo pipefail
issues.detail: data.sh aborts on wc -l mismatches against magic numbers (22467/3208/6072/...), coupling the recipe to one dataset snapshot. download_and_untar.sh also uses unquoted realpath $1 and ${2:-$extract_dir}, which will crash on paths with spaces. Quote variables and soften or document the count checks.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a standard ESPnet recipe addition with no algorithmic concerns but several contract and shell-hygiene defects. The most critical issues are a broken README config path (flagged by all three) and download_and_untar.sh failing to exit on missing prerequisites or bad arguments. A duplicate db.sh (file plus symlink at the same path) needs resolution, and run.sh disables an LM that README claims as a reproducible result. Hard-coded utterance counts and unquoted shell variables round out the cleanup list. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK with small, obvious fixes.
